question: How many stock records at warehouse 132-2 have a quantity of zero or less?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inv_current_stock s JOIN inv_locations l ON l.id = s.location_id WHERE l.name = '132-2' AND s.quantity <= 0

question: What is the stock of Hex Nut M8 at each warehouse?
reference_sql: SELECT l.name, s.quantity FROM inv_current_stock s JOIN inv_items i ON i.id = s.item_id JOIN inv_locations l ON l.id = s.location_id WHERE i.name ILIKE '%Hex Nut M8%'

question: How many stock transfers of each type (transfer_in and transfer_out) were recorded in July 2026?
reference_sql: SELECT transaction_type, COUNT(*) FROM inv_transactions WHERE transaction_type IN ('transfer_in', 'transfer_out') AND created_at >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND created_at < DATE '2026-08-01' GROUP BY transaction_type

question: What is the total quantity on hand at each warehouse?
reference_sql: SELECT l.name, SUM(s.quantity) FROM inv_current_stock s JOIN inv_locations l ON l.id = s.location_id GROUP BY l.name

question: How many stock movements of each type are there?
reference_sql: SELECT transaction_type, COUNT(*) FROM inv_transactions GROUP BY transaction_type
expected_answer:
transaction_type | count
outbound | 6
inbound | 4
transfer_in | 1
transfer_out | 1

question: Which items have never had a stock movement?
reference_sql: SELECT i.item_code FROM inv_items i WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inv_transactions t WHERE t.item_id = i.id)

question: How many active items are there?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inv_items WHERE status = 'active'

question: What is the total quantity issued to each issued-to target?
reference_sql: SELECT tg.name, SUM(t.quantity) FROM inv_transactions t JOIN inv_issued_to_targets tg ON tg.id = t.issued_to_id WHERE t.transaction_type = 'outbound' GROUP BY tg.name
expected_answer:
name | sum
D132 Shop Floor | 59
Dispatch team | 30
